name: Counters Block – Animated Number Counters, Stats & Dynamic KPIs
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Make important numbers stand out with Counters Block.

Counters Block helps you create animated number counters, business KPIs, website statistics, and milestone sections directly in the WordPress Block Editor—without coding.

Highlight completed projects, customer figures, sales metrics, and other important numbers using customizable themes, number animations, icons, and responsive layouts.

Build statistics sections for business websites, agency landing pages, portfolios, blogs, SaaS websites, and WooCommerce stores.

Live Demo | Get Premium | Documentation & Support

Features

Animated Number Counters

Create number counters with animation styles that help draw attention to important figures.

  • Classic, Rolling, Bounce, Fade, Slide, Pulse, Flip, and Typewriter animations.
  • Animation triggers for visibility, page load, hover, click, and custom CSS selectors.
  • Global and individual counter controls for animation duration, delay, and stagger.

Counter Themes & Responsive Layouts

  • 15 counter themes, including 3 free themes and 12 Premium themes.
  • Circular Progress Counter (Theme 15) with customizable ring thickness, size, colors, and line caps.
  • Responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Customizable columns, spacing, typography, backgrounds, borders, and shadows.

Dynamic WooCommerce & WordPress Statistics (Premium)

Display supported statistics from your WordPress website through the available data sources.

  • WooCommerce: Sales totals, order counts, product counts, and customer statistics.
  • Customer Counting: Supports registered customers and guest checkout data according to the plugin’s counting logic.
  • WordPress: Post counts, page counts, comment counts, and registered-user counts.
  • HPOS Compatibility: Supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Displayed values and update behavior depend on the selected data source and the plugin’s implementation.

Number Formatting & Customization

  • Custom number prefixes and suffixes.
  • Thousands separators, including commas and spaces.
  • Decimal number support.
  • Number formatting for supported dynamic sales data.
  • Custom icons from Font Awesome, Bootstrap, and Lucide.

Free vs Premium

Free Version

  • Unlimited static counters.
  • 3 counter themes.
  • Classic number animation with an on-visible trigger.
  • Responsive layouts and basic styling.
  • Icon support.

Premium Version

  • 12 additional counter themes (including the Circular Progress Counter).
  • Additional animation styles and triggers.
  • Dynamic WooCommerce and WordPress statistics.
  • Advanced formatting and styling controls.
  • Priority support.

Recommended Plugins

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Counters Block.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open a page or post in the WordPress Block Editor.
  5. Search for Counters Block in the block inserter and add it to your page.
  6. Customize your counter values, layout, and available settings.

You can also upload the plugin ZIP file through Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
sections.faq:
Is Counters Block free?

Yes. The free version includes unlimited static counters, three themes, responsive layouts, and basic customization. Premium adds additional themes, animation options, styling controls, and dynamic data sources.

Can I display WooCommerce sales statistics?

Yes. Premium supports selected WooCommerce data sources, including sales, orders, products, and customer statistics. The displayed values depend on the selected source and its counting logic.

Does the customer counter include guest shoppers?

The Premium customer data source supports guest checkout data according to the plugin’s counting logic.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Counters Block supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS). Refer to the current plugin version and WooCommerce compatibility information for details.

Will Counters Block slow down my website?

Performance depends on your website, theme, hosting environment, and other installed plugins. Test your website with your actual configuration to evaluate its performance.

Where can I get help?

Visit the WordPress.org support forum or check our Documentation & Support page.
